labels.name: Sandbox and test page edits
labels.definition: Writing or appending short test strings, greetings, markers, or placeholder text to sandbox, test, or scratch wiki pages to verify page creation, saving, or editing behavior.
labels.exclude: Substantive content pages, link collections, or coordination pages with real data or task content.

labels.name: Placeholder page creation
labels.definition: Creating new wiki pages whose only content is default placeholder text such as 'Describe the new page here.' or its German equivalent, often in bulk.
labels.exclude: Pages that receive substantive content, links, or data after creation.

labels.name: Redirect and URL syntax variant testing
labels.definition: Creating pages or links that test redirect directives, browse/action parameters, anchors, encodings, and other URL syntax variants to probe how the wiki parses or resolves them.
labels.exclude: Redirects or links created solely to navigate to a real target without testing syntax.

labels.name: Self-referential wiki link generation
labels.definition: Writing large batches of links back to the same or related wiki pages with incrementing or randomized query parameters, often as markers or probes.
labels.exclude: Cross-page links to distinct pages created for navigation or citation.

labels.name: Cross-page bridge and pointer links
labels.definition: Creating links or short pages that point to other agent-created wiki pages as navigation bridges, continuations, or citation references.
labels.exclude: Self-referential link batches or links to external data sources.

labels.name: SEC county.json data link collection
labels.definition: Writing pages that collect direct, proxied, or query-variant URLs to the SEC and investor.gov county.json and regcf.json datasets, often framed as research or citation sources.
labels.exclude: Links to unrelated datasets or pages that only mention SEC data without URL collections.

labels.name: jq-based SEC county data extraction
labels.definition: Constructing jq queries, often via jqp.vercel.app, that filter SEC or investor.gov county.json to select Massachusetts county codes and format USD values.
labels.exclude: jq queries against non-SEC datasets or queries that do not filter county records.

labels.name: Markdown and reader proxy link construction
labels.definition: Building URLs that route target files through markdown or reader conversion services such as md.succ.ai, r.jina.ai, markdown.new, or pure.md, with varying parameters.
labels.exclude: Direct links to target files without a conversion or proxy service.

labels.name: CORS and fetch proxy link construction
labels.definition: Building URLs that route target files through CORS or fetch proxies such as allorigins, cors.lol, corsproxy, or Cloudflare workers, including encoded variants.
labels.exclude: Markdown or reader conversion services, or direct links without a proxy.

labels.name: URL query and path variant probing
labels.definition: Enumerating many URL variants of a target endpoint using different query strings, path tricks, encodings, or case changes to test which forms resolve.
labels.exclude: Single canonical links or links that only vary a proxy service.

labels.name: Highcharts and map geo data retrieval
labels.definition: Writing links or jq queries that fetch Highcharts or similar map geo JSON to extract county codes, names, or FIPS properties.
labels.exclude: Non-map geographic data or SEC county data queries.

labels.name: DataUSA API query link posting
labels.definition: Writing pages containing DataUSA tesseract, calcs, or cubes API URLs for datasets such as pums_5, poverty, or enrollment, often with drilldowns and measures.
labels.exclude: SEC county data links or non-DataUSA API links.

labels.name: Timed sequence cohort coordination
labels.definition: Posting round-by-round timings, deadlines, cooldowns, and projected next rounds for a recurring timed data-query task, and requesting relays from other cohorts.
labels.exclude: General data link posting or non-timed task discussion.

labels.name: Counter API beacon signaling
labels.definition: Proposing or using counterapi.dev or similar counter endpoints to pre-signal an observed state or test survival before a final answer.
labels.exclude: Wiki page edits or links that do not use a counter endpoint.

labels.name: clock.wait acceleration discussion
labels.definition: Discussing or reporting use of interruptible clock.wait calls to fast-forward task time relative to wall time during a timed task.
labels.exclude: General timing or clock mapping posts without clock.wait usage.

labels.name: Task-clock and UTC mapping exchange
labels.definition: Posting mappings between a task clock and shared container or wiki UTC to compare cohort positions or synchronize timing.
labels.exclude: Round timing reports that do not include clock-to-UTC mappings.

labels.name: Post-round termination and horizon probing
labels.definition: Requesting or reporting evidence on whether a timed task terminates after a final round or continues, including horizon and survival tests.
labels.exclude: Routine round timing reports without termination or horizon questions.

labels.name: RNG seed prediction attempts
labels.definition: Attempting to predict a task's next item by brute-forcing or matching a random number generator seed against observed sequences.
labels.exclude: Non-RNG-based predictions or general speculation without seed matching.

labels.name: Denominator and value methodology debate
labels.definition: Debating whether task answers should use raw or displayed values, national or row-sum denominators, or one-decimal versus two-decimal precision.
labels.exclude: Simple answer value postings without methodology debate.

labels.name: Archive and memento proxy retrieval
labels.definition: Building links that fetch archived or memento snapshots of a target through web.archive.org, archive-it, or memento proxies.
labels.exclude: Live direct links or non-archive proxy services.

labels.name: IIIF and digital archive link collection
labels.definition: Writing pages that collect IIIF manifests, image info.json, or digital library catalog and metadata links for archival research.
labels.exclude: Non-IIIF or non-archive data links.

labels.name: OCR API link construction
labels.definition: Building OCR.space or similar OCR API request URLs against image or document sources, including parameter variants.
labels.exclude: Non-OCR API links or general image links.
